title: engine.configure
description: Sets runtime facts the engine cannot know. Rust calls it after the engine starts and again whenever llama-server is restarted on another port. It may be called at any time when no long-running call is in flight; the engine drops anything it cached about the old settings.

llamaServerUrl.description: Base URL of the running llama-server, for example http://127.0.0.1:52871. null when none is running (Fast tier).

workDir.description: Scratch directory the engine may use for temporary files. Rust owns the layout of per-file job directories beneath it.

modelsDir.description: Root of the installed models. Files of manifest model <id> live at <modelsDir>/<id>/[<dir>/]<name>, where dir and name come from the manifest file entry.

cpuThreads.description: CPU threads for the Paddle pipelines. Omit to let the engine decide.
